birthday_reference.interpretation: not the requested contiguous null and not used for conclusions

click_bounding_hull_width_sensitivity.warning: sensitivity counts unchanged gaps inside each bounding hull as width and overlap

full_click_textual_proxy.warning: numerator and null exposure distribution come from different cohorts; this is contextual, not an identified causal clustering effect

file_granularity_prediction.comparison_warning: the null width distribution is from handwritten, classifiable, conflict-selected paths across repositories; the measured Click rate is a complete anchored textual-conflict census

result_blob_N_sensitivity.coordinate_warning: widths are derived from base-coordinate changed spans; result-blob N is a size sensitivity, not the coordinate-correct primary denominator

granularity_curves.click_empirical_denominator_warning: base-coordinate spans are retained only for conflict-selected mined paths, not the full 684-unit Click census
granularity_curves.granularity_rule: expand each retained interval/effective insertion byte outward to every fixed file-origin-aligned g-byte block it touches; overblock iff the miner says exact changes are strict-disjoint but padded claim unions overlap

null_definition.bounding_hull_sensitivity: a named sensitivity counts unchanged gaps between first and last changed coordinates; it is not primary
null_definition.insertion_rule: an insertion-only edit contributes one effective byte at its anchor (the adjacent in-file byte at EOF)
null_definition.multi_hunk_rule: w is unioned changed-byte mass across refined intervals plus effective insertion bytes; the null places one contiguous span of that size
null_definition.primary: two positive contiguous half-open byte spans with independent uniform integer starts conditional on measured changed-byte masses w1,w2 and base_blob_size N
null_definition.scattered_reference: exp(-w1*w2/N); reported as a distinct birthday/scattered-byte reference, not used as the contiguous null

handwritten_marker_spans.pairing_note: marker spans describe disputed result regions but do not supply two side-specific widths; the paired null therefore uses unioned changed-byte masses from the mined parent-side base-coordinate spans

exposure_only_predictions.definition: two concurrent unselected tasks; combined exposure is W1+W2 in changed lines

distribution_mean_pushthrough.bound_status: sharp under monotonic hazard, integer task sizes, minimum one line, and only the retained nearest-rank constraints
distribution_mean_pushthrough.estimand: E[h(W1+W2)] for independent same-distribution task draws
distribution_mean_pushthrough.independence_assumption: W1 and W2 are independent draws with replacement
distribution_mean_pushthrough.label: independent_distribution_pushthrough
distribution_mean_pushthrough.missing_input: the 1,354 raw aggregate_claim_lines_per_write observations or a lossless histogram

exposure_only_predictions.preregistered_use: P6 exposure-only prediction for the unmediated collision rate on future unselected concurrent tasks

fit.optimizer_message: CONVERGENCE: RELATIVE REDUCTION OF F <= FACTR*EPSMCH

hazard.formula: logit(p) = alpha + beta * log(1 + combined_text_lines_changed); beta >= 0

site_conditioned_context.interpretation: all sites were selected as historical conflicts; 100% versus the mean hazard measures selection concentration beyond line exposure, not out-of-sample calibration
site_conditioned_context.preregistered_selected_site_claim: ordering only: realized selected-site collision rate above the exposure-only prediction at agent diff sizes

lease.caveat: raw interval values are absent; the optimum and curve are reconstruction-dependent, and the linger endpoint is right-censored rather than an explicit close

costs.reacquisition_derivation: p50 structured active span per core-active actor / 60; workload proxy, not measured startup overhead

definitions.expected_dangling: mean min(L,D) over reconstructed last-write-to-observed-end linger
definitions.false_expiry: fraction of reconstructed read-to-write intervals strictly greater than L

reconstruction.method: piecewise-linear quantile function through minimum=0, p50, p90, p99, and maximum; forced to reproduce reported nearest ranks
